entities.summary: Friedrich Trendelenburg was a German surgeon. He was son of the philosopher Friedrich Adolf Trendelenburg, father of the pharmacologist Paul Trendelenburg, the physiologist Wilhelm Trendelenburg and of the politician Ernst Trendelenburg and grandfather of the pharmacologist Ullrich Georg Trendelenburg.
